programme.title: PL STORIES - EP9
programme.desc: Live. From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. programme.title: CLASSIC MATCH - NEW v AVL

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Brentford (MW06) - Premier League 2026/27
programme.desc: Live. Brentford completed the double over Aston Villa last season, having won just one of their first eight Premier League games against them (D3 L4).

programme.title: Hull City vs Everton (MW06) - Premier League 2026/27
programme.desc: Live. Everton remain unbeaten in their five Premier League games this season (W2 D3), and could avoid defeat in their first six matches of a campaign in the competition for the third time, after 2006-07 (first 7) and 2013-14 (6).

programme.title: Crystal Palace vs Nottingham Forest (MW06) - Premier League 2026/27

programme.title: PL Rewind 2026/27 - EP4
programme.desc: Live. Hassan Kachloul was the first ever Moroccan player to grace the Premier League. He recalls the key matches and moments from his Saints career, including the unforgettable final game at The Dell.

programme.title: PL Stories 2026/27 - EP19
programme.desc: Live. From his early days at Wallsend Boys Club to emerging at West Ham, Michael Carrick reflects on his remarkable journey through the game. programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester City (MW06) - Premier League 2026/27
programme.desc: Live. Liverpool lost home and away to Manchester City in the Premier League last season, the first time they have lost 2+ times in succession to the Citizens in the league since March 1937 (4 in a row).

programme.title: Manchester United vs Tottenham Hotspur (MW06) - Premier League 2026/27

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.
